newsitem.title: USA: Meridian launches new distribution, product plans.
newsitem.headline: Meridian launches new distribution, product plans.

text.p: Meridian Insurance Group Inc said Friday it is launching two new initiatives through its mutual company affiliate and said the plans have "profitable growth potential."
Meridian will begin a direct marketing distribution program in the state of Washington. And beginning in 1998, it will provide a non-standard auto product to its agents in most areas.

Meridian reported second quarter income of $0.27 a share versus $0.10 in the 1996 period. The results were again affected by property damage claims resulting from severe weather, but losses were not as high as 1996's unprecedented levels, Meridian said.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates was $0.31 a share.
"While there is improvement in our second-quarter financial results, we are far from satisfied," Norma Oman, president and chief executive, said in a statement.
"Recognizing the importance of staying focused on the business fundamentals that we can control, we continue to take rate and underwriting actions to improve our loss and expense ratios," Oman added.
Meridian provides automobile, homeowners, farmowners and other personal lines of insurance and commercial insurance.
